template.name: EF Distance Reversal
template.entry_long: roc(sma(close,{p0}),{p1}) < {p0} and roc(sma(close,{p2}),1) > {p1} and atr(high,low,close,20) >= 0.01 * close
template.notes: The three-consecutive-SMA local bottom is captured with the documented SMA 10 over two and one bars plus the ATR(20) volatility filter; the documented threshold of 1 is unitless, so 1% of price is the fallback. Documented StopLoss 100 and TakeProfit 200 are price points, not percentages.
